synopsis: David Reed is the Conservative MP for Exmouth and Exeter East, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024. He currently undertakes the roles of Shadow Parliamentary Under Secretary (Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs), Shadow Minister (Defence) (Security and Resilience), and Opposition Whip (Commons).
